violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Sani cloth left at table top between uses.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. -Mop sink does not have faucet set up. (Water available at high spigot outside kitchen area.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. -Paper towels were not stocked at hand sink. *No dispenser installed. *Loose roll of paper towels stocked immediately.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Secondary container of poisonous or toxic material was not clearly identified to indicated contents. -Spray bottle stated as bleach was not labeled with contents.
